evals.name: nuxt-preset
evals.prompt: In a Nuxt app using the xcvzmoon motion-vue fork (motion-v 2.12.0), configure a global v-fade-in preset that reveals content once on entry. Show nuxt.config.ts and a minimal page. Explain defaults, which imports are needed, whether function variants can live in module presets, and SSR/reduced-motion checks. Do not modify the app.
evals.expected_output: Working Nuxt motionV config, serializable preset, correct in-view options, accurate auto-import limits and accessible SSR guidance.
assertions: Uses motion-v/nuxt and the motionV config key.
Uses presets with whileInView and inViewOptions.once, and v-fade-in on a native element.
Explains that module presets are JSON serialized and function variants need a handwritten plugin.
Correctly distinguishes directive default false from component/utility defaults true.
Includes concrete SSR and reduced-motion verification.

evals.name: accessible-reorder
evals.prompt: Build a self-contained Vue SFC for a reorderable list using xcvzmoon/motion-vue motion-v 2.12.0. It should support pointer and keyboard sorting, cancellation, visible focus and an explanation of axis auto-detection, update callback arguments, scroll/RTL behavior, stable IDs, and reduced motion. Do not add a second drag library or duplicate built-in keyboard handlers. Do not modify the app.
evals.expected_output: Fork-correct Reorder SFC with v-model:values, stable values, keyboard instructions/focus, canonical reducedMotion, accurate fork behaviors.
assertions: Binds values with v-model:values or :values plus @update:values and writes new order back.
Uses stable item keys and values and provides visible keyboard focus.
Explains built-in Space/arrows/Escape handling without adding duplicate handlers.
Explains omitted-axis detection including xy grid support.
Describes update:values(newOrder, moved) and updates during drag.
Addresses reducedMotion, RTL and scrolling without claiming unsupported cross-container transfers.
